messages:
Jess: Quick update — AstraSilicon NDA is countersigned (finally). We should lock the EAP bench plan and shipment window this week.
Maria: Nice, thanks. Can you drop the NDA link? I need to confirm redaction clauses for microcode. :thumbsup:
Jess: Here: https://redwood.share/ndas/astra-2026 (internal). Legal-bot confirmed last night.
legal-bot: NDA status: countersigned by AstraSilicon. Sensitive sections flagged: driver blobs, silicon microcode. See comments.
Omar: For benching I propose we run two passes: 1) default fp16 run for baseline 2) int8 quant profile for cost perf. Script is `run_bench.sh` with model variants.
Liam: Can you paste example command? Ops needs it for the infra checklist.
Omar: Sure —
```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-v1-7b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --profile fp16 --out s3://redwood-bench/astra/2026-03
./run_bench.sh --model redwood-v1-7b --batch 16 --seq 1024 --profile int8 --quant-config q4_0 --out s3://redwood-bench/astra/2026-03
```
Jess: @astra-poc what's ETA on the dev boards shipment? We need arrival + driver image (they said custom kernel). :ship:
astra-poc: Shipping Wed 2026-03-05, courier tracking TBA. Driver image `astra-rt-2026-03.img` will be uploaded to our portal. We'll provide checksum and install notes.
ops-sam: Once we have image, can we get a golden AMI/container so our infra can spin up tests automatically?
astra-poc: Yes — we'll provide a tar of the reference container and a smoke test script.
bench-bot: bench run queued on infra-eks-3. Expected runtime ~3h. Will post results to s3://redwood-bench/astra/runs/1839001234.json when done.
Maria: Important: telemetry/extracted logs must not include microcode dumps. Legal flagged that. Omar — please ensure bench logs are scrubbed before upload.
Omar: Will sanitize logs in the harness; keeping only perf counters and model outputs. Using `--anonymize-logs` flag in the script.
Liam: Can we add perf counters for PCIe bandwidth, kernel GPU occupancy, and p50/p99 latency per token? Need for the partner report.
Omar: Yep — adding `--counters pcie,occupancy,latency`. Bench harness will output CSV and JSON summary.
bench-bot: bench run complete. Summary: throughput=1240 tokens/sec (fp16), p50=12ms/token, p99=49ms/token. int8 pass pending (queued). Full JSON: s3://redwood-bench/astra/runs/1839001234.json
Jess: Sweet. Next steps: (1) confirm ship date + driver (astra-poc), (2) infra golden image (ops-sam), (3) run int8 + produce partner report (omar), (4) legal sign-off on scrubbed results (maria). I'll coordinate a quick sync Thu to review numbers. :calendar: 
Maria: I'll review scrubbed outputs and confirm compliance, please ping when int8 is done.
astra-poc: Noted — pushing driver and container by EOD Tue.
Liam: Scheduling 2h block on Thu for the post-run review. I'll invite infra and product.
Jess: Thanks all. If anyone hits blocker, drop it here or DM. :eyes:
